authority.note: Commander counterfactual simulator deltas are bounded test evidence only; they cannot decide commander value or deck changes.

limitations: Goldfish/proxy results are not multiplayer win rates or estimates of real-game win probability.
The unavailable mode removes commander access without adding a replacement library card; this isolates command-zone availability rather than changing deck size.
The taxed mode is a sensitivity point (+2 starting generic commander cost), not a distribution of commander tax in real games.
The disrupted mode reuses the legacy deterministic commander-removal stress hook; multi-commander decks receive a bounded one-at-a-time proxy, not simultaneous pair disruption.
First key-set access means access to any member, not package completion or engine-online probability.
v1.1 omits many commander-native mechanics; structural Blueprint evidence must be read alongside dynamic deltas.
No scalar commander-dependence score is produced.

disruption_recovery.scenario: commander_removed_twice from turn 4; for multi-commander decks the legacy stress hook removes one on-board commander at a time and is therefore only a bounded disruption proxy

disrupted.note: first_key_set_access means first access to any member of the simulator key set; it is not package completion or engine-online probability.

modes.disrupted: existing commander_removed_twice stress proxy from turn 4

modes.unavailable: commander(s) absent for entire game; 99-card library unchanged

accepted_blueprint_role.advances_plan: Sol'Kanar is repeatable end-step value, and his fourth mode is a political gift.
accepted_blueprint_role.honest_note: Honest call: significant, not central. All four Spellbook combos (Demonic Pact + Donate / Harmless Offering / Blim / Coveted Falcon) work without him. He adds value through blink resets but the kills are the cursed-gift package. The source calls the plan slower and more board-dependent than cEDH (blueprint L22).

unmodeled_required_dimensions: true meaningful-action count (v1.1 does not expose cast/action events)
commander-native triggered/activated value not represented by v1.1 mechanics
exact partner-pair disruption of both commanders simultaneously
